source.generator: F124-AF exact four-family builder bytecode with cohort rebinding only; original first-admissible source guard and reference unchanged.

Yggdrasil.hypothesis: Source-blind raw-bit continuity violation at each causal transition should be penalized in accumulation and ranking BEFORE original 7-active/9-retained pruning, not just normalizing terminal value.
Yggdrasil.scoring: Reuse original AB forward bytewise except per-hop candidate value := original_value - eta*max(0,Hamming16(previous_carried_dest_bits,current_src_bits)-1), with zero penalty on first hop. Eligibility tolerates 1 noisy-bit difference. Use original rank score, retained sort, gamma=.25 soft accumulator, AD anchor10 readout, penalty=.25. ETA0 exact original AB 7+9 candidates and AD logit and work counters, apart from separately declared new raw-bit comparisons.
Yggdrasil.fit_selection: Maximize exact 48 paired independent FIT accuracy, tie prefer 0 then smallest eta; freeze before first DEV.
metrics: model original score and hard-pruning parity at eta0

Wingless.hypothesis: Single packed state can accumulate a source-blind compressed transition mismatch cost per hop, discouraging spurious causal continuations without a global threshold shift.
Wingless.scoring: Preserve original AA single 12-bit four-channel state per node and ranking, use original score plus a *per hop* penalty eta*max(0,n_mismatched_3bit_checksum_channels(previous_carried_dst,current_edge_src)-1) on both transition score and rank, zero on first hop. ETA0 bitwise reproduces original AA output and all original work counters.
Wingless.fit_selection: 48 new FIT paired exact classification, tie eta0 then smaller eta; DEV untouched until selection.
metrics: matched public graph runtime/peak Python allocations
